info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Units API

params.name: propertyId
params.description: Origin property ID (the one being merged away).

params.name: targetPropertyId
params.description: Target property ID (the one that will be kept).

items.docs:
Merges the origin property (`propertyId`) into the target property (`targetPropertyId`). The
origin is soft-deleted and its occupancies / residents are re-parented to the target. When
`transfer_rooms` is `true`, the origin's room configuration is merged onto the target.
This resource allows you to create a Unit. Units are single properties that can be occupied by one or more residents.

params.name: id[]
params.description:
The ids of the units to be deleted. Repeat the parameter to send
multiple values (e.g. `?id[]=abc&id[]=def`). The query string must
contain `id[]`, and a missing array
surfaces as a 500. Individual entries are not validated; ids the
caller cannot access are silently skipped.

items.docs: This resource allows you to delete multiple units at once.

info.name: Create a property (unit) from a Zapier trigger

params.name: orgId
params.description:
Optional organization id override. Only used when the caller's
auth token does not already carry `orgId`.

items.docs:
Zapier-flavoured entry point for the v1 unit create flow. The Zapier
request body carries a flat property payload; `full_bathrooms` /
`half_bathrooms` are derived from the single `bathrooms` value, the
region name is resolved from the state, and the request is delegated to
the v1 unit create flow. The `orgId` is taken from the caller's decoded
auth token, falling back to the `orgId` query parameter when the token
has none.
